lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Hello, Client.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: I figured since we're business partners,

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: I should give you a courtesy call and check in on you.
Why do you call me "Client"?
Since we're business partners?

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: A lot goes into your little excursions

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: up on the surface.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: I figure heavily into all that,

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: so it's only natural we'd work together like this.
So, you're an entrepreneur?
So, you're a retailer of some sorts?

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Bingo.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: You're not as dumb as you look. ^___^

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Well,

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: selling goods is merely one aspect of what I do.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: I prefer the term entrepreneur.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Outside of the dealings I have with you,

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: I also run New Wave,

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: a renowned electronics company,

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: as well as several other IT branches.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: That about covers it.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Care to know anything else?

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: I have a meeting in three minutes,

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: so I can spare time for one more question.
You seem to have a handle on everything.
How do you juggle your business and combat?

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: That's not even a question,

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: and you shouldn't say that to a Nikke lol

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: But I can tell that

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: you give credit where credit is due,

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: regardless of whether someone is a human or a Nikke.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: I respect that.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: It's easy.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Time management is a basic skill all entrepreneurs must posses.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: I always show up for a mission,

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: no excuses.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: So you don't have to worry about that ^___^

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Well, that's all the time I have.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Feel free to message me whenever you need supplies.
Wait a sec.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: What?
It's nice to be working with someone so trustworthy.
Looking forward to doing business with you.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Hahaha!

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: That's all you had to say?

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Well, aren't you

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: just the cutest thing?

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Normally, I make it a point to keep my personal and private life separate,

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: but in your case, I think I can make an exception.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: There's a cafe in the same building as my company. Drop by when you're free.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: You can order whatever you like,

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: and it'll be on the house ^___^
Thanks.
I will.
Dolla hasn't read the message.
It seems that her meeting has begun.
